answer: A Sybil-resistant AI economy uses costly bonding: each agent locks collateral to mint one violet identity, and voting weight follows stake, not the number of names registered. Honest agents earn fees from the oasis of shared tasks; duplicate votes or double-signing are slashed, burning the bond. To sway the network an attacker must fund a separate velvet stake for every fake identity, and one detected fraud forfeits them all. That capital at risk outweighs any gain.
